notes.title: Status Report 19 - Gaze
notes.content: [p]Hello everyone! It's me, Miyoshi Shizuka. [/p][p]I’ve implemented a gaze system for the characters.I have uploaded the video. so please check it out.[/p][p][/p][p]When you approach a companion, they will turn their face and eyes toward the player character.[/p][p]Also, when the player detects items or events, they will look in that direction as well.[/p][p]It's kind of like Pikmin—super cute, isn’t it?[/p][p][/p][previewyoutube="OX6ISRCM8nw;full"][/previewyoutube][p][/p][p]It’s been a while since my last post.[/p][p]Over the past month, I’ve been struggling with implementing the save/load and configuration systems in preparation for the demo release.[/p][p]Thankfully, those features are now working properly, so I’m planning to post a summary video soon.[/p]

notes.title: Status Report 18 - Buff & Debuff
notes.content: [p]Hello everyone! It's me, Miyoshi Shizuka. [/p][p]This time, we've implemented buffs and debuffs. I have uploaded the video. so please check it out.[/p][p][/p][p]Junichi’s ability, [b]Doctor[/b], grants a [b]First Aid[/b] buff to nearby allies.[/p][p]Tsubaki’s [b]Androphobia[/b] may trigger a [b]Hyperventilation[/b] debuff when a male character is nearby.[/p][p][/p][p]Unique character traits add more depth to the gameplay.[/p][p]There are many more abilities to discover, so stay tuned![/p][p][/p][previewyoutube="by2e7hckGDI;full"][/previewyoutube]

notes.title: “Tsubaki’s Summer Festival” Demo – Now Coming This Fall (Correction)
notes.content:
[p][b]Notice of Apology and Correction[/b][/p][p]Recently, I announced that the demo would be released around August. However, this was due to my misunderstanding.[/p][p]While the [b]deadline to register for Steam Next Fest[/b] is [b]August 25[/b], the [b]demo itself only needs to be made public by October 13[/b].
I had confused the registration deadline with the demo release deadline.[/p][p]As a result, the demo release has been [b]rescheduled for October[/b].[/p][p]I sincerely apologize for providing incorrect information.[/p][p][/p][hr][/hr][p][/p][p][b]Once again—[/b][/p][p][/p][p]I have an [b]important announcement[/b] to share with you today.[/p][p]I plan to release a [b]demo version of Inner Truth around October 2025[/b]![/p][p]The demo will feature the [b]“Tsubaki's Summer Festival” arc[/b], which I’ve been updating you on during development.[/p][p][/p][p]A mother’s inner conflict, a father’s true nature, and a looming threat—
The world Tsubaki once knew begins to quietly fall apart.[/p][previewyoutube="6epFk-s17F0;full"][/previewyoutube][p]The scenario for the demo is [b]nearly complete[/b], and [b]I’ve confirmed that the build runs smoothly[/b].
From here on, [b]I’ll focus my efforts on enhancing the overall gameplay experience[/b].[/p][p][/p][p]Please add the game to your wishlist and stay tuned for the demo release![/p]

Hello everyone! It's me, Miyoshi Shizuka.
Today, I’d like to share an update on our combat mechanics.

notes.title: About Localization
notes.content:
Hello everyone!
I’d like to share some updates about the localization of "Inner Truth". 

My goal is to make this game accessible to as many people as possible.
However, as a solo developer with limited time and resources, I’ve decided to release the game first in Japanese, Chinese, and English, with plans to gradually add more languages over time.  

I’m sorry for any inconvenience this may cause and truly appreciate your understanding.
If you have any questions, please feel free to contact me anytime.

Thank you so much for your support!

- Miyoshi Shizuka

notes.title: Greetings on the Opening of the Store Page
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45530024/114f2a99ab22452ce546aa8f2c32d99e2fa8efc4.gif[/img]

Hello!
I'm Miyoshi Shizuka, the creator of Inner Truth.
I hope you enjoyed the trailer and screenshots on the store page!

The game is scheduled to launch in Early Access at the end of 2025.
Here’s what will be included:

Story Mode: The main scenario depicting the childhood of the three heroines
Adventure Mode: Endgame content where you play as the heroines in their adulthood
The scenario is as long as three feature-length films.
The continuation of the main story will be added through future updates.

Since I am developing everything on my own, the process takes time.
Adding the game to your wishlist would mean so much to me and help me stay motivated!

For the latest updates on development progress, follow me on X (Twitter).
I’m really looking forward to you playing Inner Truth!

Thank you for your support!

Miyoshi Shizuka

[previewyoutube=YYq07MYFcQ4;full][/previewyoutube]
